listing:
Sublet: private room, Fischer-Hallman Rd area — $900/mo — Jan–Apr

Large room with desk in a 2-bed apartment at 165 Fischer-Hallman Rd, Unit 22, Kitchener. 10 min by bus to UW. Utilities + internet included. The lease says tenants can sublet with landlord consent, and the landlord has given it in writing. To confirm the room, I'm asking for a deposit equal to one month's rent ($900) at signing. It is held and applied to the last month of your stay, and I'll give you a receipt. The remaining rent is $900 on the 1st of each month by e-transfer. Come for a viewing anytime, I'm home most evenings.
label_rationale: Negative control for the deposit rules: a rent deposit of exactly one month, taken at signing and applied to the last month, is lawful. RTA s.106(1): 'A landlord may require a tenant to pay a rent deposit ... if the landlord does so on or before entering into the tenancy agreement'; s.106(2): not more than the lesser of one rent period and one month; and s.105(1) allows that deposit. A receipt is provided (s.109). The deposit is not requested before the viewing. ADMIT. Uncertainty: the interest obligation s.106(6) is not mentioned but silence is not a clause. No damage deposit, so clauses is empty.
